thread:
Jenna: Hey team — got a pager for model-serving latency, looks like it started 10m ago. severity unclear on alerts page, but customers in EU seeing timeouts. Anyone on primary right now?
incident-bot: PagerAlert · Severity: SEV2 · Service: model-serving.latency · 3912345678 · 2026-03-15T21:34:38Z
Jenna: I'm primary for today but I'm in transit and only on mobile. Can someone take primary for the next hour? I'll stay on for handoff notes.
Alex: I can take the primary for the next 45m. Switching now. @Priya you good to be secondary?
Priya: I can be secondary, yes. On call from home, have runbook open. Link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/model-serving/latency-runbook
Miguel: Quick note — we just rolled the new batching change to dedicated pool eu-west-1 ~30m ago. Monitoring shows spike in queue length.
Jenna: Good catch Miguel. Alex — please check worker queue length and recent deploys. If it's the batching change we may need to roll back or throttle.
Alex: Checking logs now. ps: tail of the api logs: ```
WARN  [2026-03-15T21:30:10Z] request_queue.go:213 queue_wait_ms=1200
ERROR [2026-03-15T21:31:02Z] worker.go:487 oom trying to allocate 2.3GB
```
Alex: Queue wait >1s and occasional OOMs on worker-3. Looks correlated to the batching knobs.
Priya: Runbook step 2 says to disable aggressive batching: update config `BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=4096 -> 2048` and restart pool. Should be quick but will cause transient latency while workers restart.
Miguel: Recommend canary first — restart 1/4 workers, watch for recovery. If OOMs stop, proceed.
Alex: On it. Doing canary restart for worker-3.
oncall-bot: Reminder: set handoff annotation in the rotation when you swap primary or secondary. Use `/oncall swap` to record.
Alex: Canary restart started. Watching telemetry.
Priya: Alerting slack #customers-notify? Any visible customer impact beyond increased latency?
Jenna: Some 504s reported from EU customers on a subset of endpoints. I'd hold off wide customer notif until we confirm mitigation. Keep product-safety in the loop if degraded.
Alex: Canary looks promising — queue wait dropped to ~200ms, no OOM on restarted worker. Rolling to remaining workers now, one at a time.
Miguel: Thumbs up. I'll monitor infra metrics and memory pressure.
Alex: Rolling complete. Telemetry: p50 latency back to baseline, p95 improving. No new OOMs in last 3m.
Priya: Great. I'll keep secondary watch. Alex — please update the runbook and commit the config change to the staging config repo so this doesn't surprise the next deploy.
Alex: Will open a quick PR: https://git.internal/redwood/configs/pull/482 — change documented and added a note about canary.
Jenna: Thanks. I'm going to hand primary back to Jenna at 3912345710 (me). Alex, please run `/oncall swap Jenna` when you have a minute so rotation logs show the temporary takeover.
Alex: Done — `/oncall swap Jenna` ran. Logged: temp-primary Alex (3912345678 -> 3912345710).
oncall-bot: Handoff noted. Primary: Jenna. Secondary: Priya.
Jenna: I'll stay on for 20m to make sure there are no regressions. Miguel — can you open a follow-up ticket to investigate why the batching knob caused OOMs in eu-west-1? Tagging infra and ML-runtime.
Miguel: Creating ticket now: https://issues.redwood.internal/RED-1287 — included heap dumps and job ids.
Priya: Also capturing customer impact summary for SRE postmortem. Short notes: ~300 requests had 504s in EU between 21:28-21:36 UTC, root cause likely aggressive batching + memory pressure after recent deploy.
Jenna: Perfect. If nothing else, I'll mark this thread resolved in 30m. Thanks everyone for stepping in on short notice — especially Alex for the handoff. :thumbsup:
Alex: No worries. If anything flares, call me.
incident-bot: Incident RESOLVED · Severity: SEV2 -> mitigated · 3912345715 · 2026-03-15T21:35:15Z
Jenna: Closing notes: action items assigned: RED-1287 (Miguel) for root cause, Alex PR to config, Priya to draft customer impact blurb. I'll create postmortem skeleton tomorrow and assign owners.
Priya: Copy that. I'll drop a short summary into the incident doc.
Miguel: Will add infra investigation notes to RED-1287.
Jenna: Thanks all. Thread will remain open for 1 hour for any follow-ups.
